niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers clean, structured interfaces with strong hierarchy, generous spacing, soft rounded shapes, and clear focal areas. They often favor light neutral backgrounds with dark text and soft purple/lavender accents, though in some dark-mode cases they still prefer higher contrast, clearer emphasis, and more polished visual separation. They like centered or clearly framed compositions, distinct cards or modal containers, obvious call-to-action buttons, warm photographic or soft illustrative imagery, and layouts that feel friendly, calm, and easy to scan rather than dense, technical, cluttered, or low-contrast.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers interfaces where the headline, primary content, sections, and actions are clearly prioritized with strong emphasis, focused flow, and easy scanning rather than flat, competing, or weakly organized layouts.
Prefers generous whitespace, larger padding, clearer separation between sections, and layouts that feel airy rather than tightly packed or crowded.
Usually prefers light or neutral backgrounds with dark text, better legibility, and soft accent colors over dark, heavy, or low-contrast interfaces.
Prefers rounded cards, pill-shaped buttons, softer borders, and an overall gentle, polished, approachable visual style rather than sharp, rectangular, or harsh treatments.
Prefers content organized into distinct cards, panels, checklists, overlays, or modal containers with clear boundaries instead of flat flows, dense rows, or weak separation.
Prefers visible, emphasized action controls such as full-width or clearly highlighted buttons with strong presence over missing, weak, or less obvious actions.

Prefers warm photographic hero images, soft filled illustrations, and purple or warm-toned accents that feel inviting and cohesive rather than abstract, technical, neon, or colder blue/green treatments.
